rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when you mean one person rather than a group.

example.english: This gift is for one individual.
example.traditional: 呢份禮物係畀一個人嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 hai6 bei2 jat1 go3 jan4 ge3

rows.note: Use this when contrasting an individual with a group or discussing people as separate units.

example.english: Apart from groups, an individual can register too.
example.traditional: 團體以外，個人都可以報名。
example.jyutping: tyun4 tai2 ji5 ngoi6 go3 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 bou3 meng2

rows.note: Use this for an individual as a distinct unit, especially in technical or academic contexts.

example.english: Each individual in this experiment will be recorded separately.
example.traditional: 喺呢個實驗入面，每個個體都會獨立記錄。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 sat6 jim6 jap6 min6 mui5 go3 go3 tai2 dou1 wui5 duk6 lap6 gei3 luk6

rows.note: Use this only for a private individual or citizen as opposed to an official, institution, or organization.

example.english: As a private individual, you do not need to disclose this information.
example.traditional: 作為私人，你唔需要公開呢啲資料。
example.jyutping: zok3 wai4 si1 jan4 nei5 m4 seoi1 jiu3 gung1 hoi1 ni1 di1 zi1 liu2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when each person or thing is considered separately rather than as a group.

example.english: This time, please answer the questions individual.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 cing2 go3 bit6 wui4 daap3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this for something personal or intended for one person's use, such as a personal pension.

example.english: I want to open an individual account instead of sharing one with my family.
example.traditional: 我想開個人戶口，唔同屋企人共用。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 hoi1 go3 jan4 wu6 hau2 m4 tung4 uk1 kei2 jan4 gung6 jung6

rows.note: Use this specifically for facilities, products, or arrangements designed for one person, such as a single room or ticket.

example.english: This hotel has individual rooms that are suitable for one individual.
example.traditional: 呢間酒店有單人房，啱一個人住。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 jau5 daan1 jan4 fong2 ngaam1 jat1 go3 jan4 zyu6
